title: Verified retrieval contracts and field-specific conversion configuration
text: Configured retrieval contracts verified against bounded Simpson source metadata and native reference reads on 2026-11-03. tickets.complaintRecord.natureOfCustomerComplaint references simpsoncodes._id; retain code, description, codeType and active. tickets.serviceEngineer references users._id; retrieve name and active only. tickettimelines.ticketId references tickets._id; stage, description and createdAt are recorded observations, not confirmed lifecycle transitions. jointinspectionreports.dateOfFailure accepts explicit DD-MM-YYYY or ISO calendar dates; dateOfInspection accepts ISO calendar dates or ISO timestamp calendar components without timezone invention. Ticket engineNo and enginedetails.engineSerialNumber permit exact serial candidate lookup only; company/model equality does not establish physical identity. No fallback to another business date. Work-order complaintReferenceNumber requires a verified reference contract before traversal.
